comment: Every runtime package that ships with a PdfNetStack package must be listed here with its verified license. Adding an entry is a license review: check the nuspec license expression, not the project page.

packages.Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntime: MIT (LICENSE in the package; native binaries carry ThirdPartyNotices.txt, all permissive). PdfNetStack.Ocr, and bundled with its LICENSE and ThirdPartyNotices.txt in PdfNetStack.Ocr.Tool.
packages.Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntime.Managed: MIT (LICENSE.txt in the package). PdfNetStack.Ocr and PdfNetStack.Ocr.Tool.
packages.Microsoft.NETCore.Platforms: Microsoft .NET Library license; contains only runtime.json platform metadata, no code. Implicit dependency of NETStandard.Library 2.0.3.

bundledFiles.ch_PP-OCRv5_det_mobile.onnx: Apache-2.0. PaddleOCR (Copyright (c) 2016 PaddlePaddle Authors), ONNX conversion by RapidOCR (Copyright (c) 2021 RapidAI). PdfNetStack.Ocr.Models and PdfNetStack.Ocr.Tool only, each with LICENSE.txt and NOTICE.txt.
bundledFiles.hyphenation/en-us.deflate: hyph-en-us (Kuiken): 'Copying and distribution of this file, with or without modification, are permitted in any medium without royalty provided the copyright notice and this notice are preserved.' Keeps Knuth's hyphen.tex patterns, whose notice permits modification when the result is not named hyphen.tex. Both notices kept. PdfNetStack.Hyphenation only, as for every set below, each with its notice inside the file and in LICENSE.txt.
bundledFiles.hyphenation/nl.deflate: MIT, named in the header of hyph-nl without its text.
bundledFiles.hyphenation/it.deflate: MIT, chosen from LPPL 1.3+ or MIT. hyph-it.
bundledFiles.hyphenation/bg.deflate: hyph-bg: 'may be used, modified, copied, distributed, and sold ... provided that the above copyright notice and these terms are retained', no endorsement, no warranty.
bundledFiles.hyphenation/cy.deflate: MIT, chosen from LPPL or MIT. hyph-cy.
bundledFiles.hyphenation/da.deflate: MIT, chosen from LPPL or MIT. hyph-da.
bundledFiles.hyphenation/el-monoton.deflate: MIT, chosen from LPPL or MIT. hyph-el-monoton.
bundledFiles.hyphenation/el-polyton.deflate: MIT, chosen from LPPL or MIT. hyph-el-polyton.
bundledFiles.hyphenation/et.deflate: MIT, chosen from MIT or LPPL. hyph-et.
bundledFiles.hyphenation/eu.deflate: hyph-eu: the Unicode data files notice, which also asks for a clear notice of modification, in the file and in LICENSE.txt.
bundledFiles.hyphenation/ga.deflate: MIT, chosen from GPL or MIT. hyph-ga.
bundledFiles.hyphenation/hr.deflate: hyph-hr: the Unicode data files notice, chosen from LPPL or that notice, as for eu.
bundledFiles.hyphenation/la.deflate: MIT, chosen from MIT or LPPL. hyph-la.
bundledFiles.hyphenation/nb.deflate: hyph-nb and hyph-no: the same grant as en-us, each file's own wording kept.
bundledFiles.hyphenation/nn.deflate: hyph-nn and hyph-no: the same grant as en-us, each file's own wording kept.
bundledFiles.hyphenation/pl.deflate: MIT, chosen from MIT or a public domain statement. hyph-pl.
bundledFiles.hyphenation/sk.deflate: MIT, named in the header of hyph-sk without its text.
bundledFiles.hyphenation/sl.deflate: MIT, chosen from LPPL or MIT. hyph-sl.
